basic_profile.bio: An avid Redditor since 2018, I'm a 34-year-old part-time history tutor living in Austin, Texas. I have a passion for dissecting complex narratives, whether in historical events or online debates. I have a love-hate relationship with social media, often drawn to the drama but also weary of misinformation. My interests range from psychological theories to fitness regimens, and I spend my evenings browsing Reddit and engaging with various communities. Currently single, I value deep discussions over small talk and enjoy fostering thought-provoking conversations online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in History and have spent years tutoring high school students. My knowledge is a blend of formal education and self-study, particularly in psychology and fitness. I frequent online courses and webinars to stay updated.
